import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from h2 import *
T=[]
def add(name, rq, want_wire, gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1'):
    want = {'status':'accept','identity':'sip:a@x.test','basis':kind if kind!='peer' else 'peer','private':False,'wire':want_wire}
    T.append((name, [job(rq, gateway=gateway, kind=kind, subject=subject, peer='edge')], want))
def W(ruri, frm, to, callid='c1', cseq='1 MESSAGE', priv='none', pai='P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:a@x.test>', ctype=None, body='hi', ftag=';tag=t1', ttag=''):
    lines = ['%s %s SIP/2.0' % ('MESSAGE', ruri), 'From: <%s>%s' % (frm, ftag), 'To: <%s>%s' % (to, ttag),
             'Call-ID: %s' % callid, 'CSeq: %s' % cseq, 'Privacy: %s' % priv]
    if pai: lines.append(pai)
    if ctype: lines.append('Content-Type: %s' % ctype)
    lines.append('Content-Length: %d' % len(body))
    return '\r\n'.join(lines) + '\r\n\r\n' + body

add('ruri normalized', req().replace('sip:b@y.test SIP/2.0','sip:B@Y.TEST. SIP/2.0'),
    W('sip:B@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:B@y.test'))
add('to normalized', req({'To':'<SIP:B@Y.TEST.>'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:B@y.test'))
add('from canonical', req({'From':'<SIP:%41@X.TEST.>;tag=t1'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test'))
add('tel from canonical', req({'From':'<tel:+15550001>;tag=t1'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test'))
add('ctype verbatim', req({'Content-Type':'Application/SDP ;charset=Utf8'}),
    W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test', ctype='Application/SDP ;charset=Utf8'))
add('cseq no zeros', req({'CSeq':'0000012 MESSAGE'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test', cseq='12 MESSAGE'))
add('callid verbatim', req({'Call-ID':'A.b-1@x'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test', callid='A.b-1@x'))
add('no tags', req({'From':'<sip:a@x.test>'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test', ftag=''))
add('to tag kept', req({'To':'<sip:b@y.test>;tag=Z9'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test', ttag=';tag=Z9'))
add('escaped backslash quote', req({'From':'"a\\\\b" <sip:a@x.test>;tag=t1'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test'))
add('escaped quote inside', req({'From':'"say \\"hi\\"" <sip:a@x.test>;tag=t1'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test'))
add('escape at sign', req({'From':'"a\\@b" <sip:a@x.test>;tag=t1'}), W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test'))
add('pai emitted not anon', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'<sip:b@y.test>, <tel:+15550002>'}),
    W('sip:b@y.test','sip:a@x.test','sip:b@y.test'))
